# pve_node_certificate_custom (Resource)

Custom certificate chain and key uploaded to a node's pveproxy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_certificate_custom" "example" {
  certificates = "CHANGE_ME"
  node         = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificates` (String) PEM encoded certificate (chain).
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `filename` (String) (default: pveproxy-ssl.pem)
- `force` (Boolean) Overwrite existing custom or ACME certificate files. (default: 0)
- `key` (String, Sensitive) PEM encoded private key.
- `restart` (Boolean) Restart pveproxy. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/filename (also the `terraform import` format).
